summary: Iteration 6 retest of the iteration_5 fixes. Backend: ran all tests serially (-n 0), 80/80 pass. That covers the 2 in-process email tests in test_free_templates.py, which I rewrote for the new BackgroundTasks signature, plus a new test_iteration6_free_fixes.py. Verified: free checkout with EARLY20 or a bogus code does not increment uses and stores discount_code ''; the free email has the FREE TEMPLATE READY copy with no GPay or PAYMENT CONFIRMED; the paid email still says PAYMENT CONFIRMED and GPay; the free checkout response comes back in under 5s while the email is sent in a background task (a real send to delivered@resend.dev came back email_status=sent); a resubmit after rejection is blocked when the code is used up and charges one use when the code is still available; the promo endpoint works; admin GET and mutation endpoints return 401 without auth. Frontend (desktop 1920 and mobile 390): the promo banner shows on the home page and the paid product page and is hidden on free product pages; dismiss stays hidden for the session; paid checkout auto-applies EARLY20 and shows ₹499 struck through with ₹399, and its intro says 'pay with GPay'; free checkout shows Free, has no discount field, marks step 02 'Free download' active, says 'instantly', and the submit button reads 'Get my free template'; the free success page shows TEMPLATE READY and downloads a real PDF (free-weekly-planner.pdf); quick view, saved items surviving a reload, and the workbook preview (1/3 to 3/3, prev disabled on page 1 and next disabled on page 3, close) all work; no horizontal overflow; no console errors. Found 2 minor copy/design issues.

minor.issue: The free email footer still says 'Sent by Morrow Market because you bought from our store'. A free template was not bought; suggest 'because you ordered from our store' when is_free.
Free checkout has no rate limit and sends a real email to any address supplied. It could be abused to spam arbitrary inboxes. Consider light throttling per email or IP.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing period: renders 'we'll send your template instantly No account needed.' The free branch string needs a trailing '.' (App.js Checkout: "we'll send your template instantly.").

issues: The page counter wraps onto two lines ('2 /' then '3') because .preview-head>span has padding-right:44px and no white-space:nowrap. Add white-space:nowrap and flex-shrink:0.
The sheet is narrow on mobile: with the 42px modal padding plus the 28px arrow columns, the h3 wraps to 6–8 lines. Consider reducing .modal-card padding to about 24px under 800px.

action_items: Add the missing period to the free checkout intro copy
Preview counter on mobile: add white-space:nowrap to .preview-head>span; reduce modal-card padding on mobile
Optional: throttle free checkout email sends
critical_code_review_comments: is_admin() returns True when CLERK_SECRET_KEY == ''. This fails open if the key is ever set to blank; prefer failing closed.
The Success page keeps polling every 15s even after payment_status is 'paid' (free orders are paid instantly). Stop the interval once paid.
The CheckoutProgress prop name 'hasDiscount' controls whether step 02 is active. Works, but the semantics are confusing.
The admin add-product price input has min=1, so the owner cannot create new free templates from the UI (backend allows ge=0). Confirm this is intended.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_free_templates.py (in-process email tests updated for the BackgroundTasks signature; polling for email_status)

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all flows pass; 1 copy typo, 1 mobile counter wrap)
